leads: Trizen Packaging manufactures eraser and sharpener packs from our ISO 9001:2015 certified facility in Vapi, Gujarat — custom APET crystal-clear blister packs and multi-cavity trays for the complete eraser and sharpener range. OEM stationery packaging from Vapi for eraser manufacturers, sharpener companies, and school supply brands. APET blister packs for individual erasers, eraser multi-packs, single-hole and dual-hole sharpeners, and combo eraser-and-sharpener retail packs.

Eraser and sharpener packaging uses APET crystal-clear thermoforming for the same reason as pen packaging — the consumer must see the product design, colour, and size through the packaging. Premium novelty erasers and designer sharpeners use their product design as the primary purchase signal. APET crystal-clear communicates product quality and lets the eraser's design sell the product at the retail shelf.

sections.st: Three Problems Eraser & Sharpener Packs Buyers Face

strips.title: Small Stationery Items Not Visible — Purchase Signal Lost
strips.desc: Problem: Erasers and sharpeners in opaque or low-clarity packaging hide the product design and colour — the consumer cannot see what they are selecting. Solution: APET crystal-clear thermoforming for all eraser and sharpener retail packaging — product design, colour, and shape fully visible through the packaging.

strips.title: Loose Items in Multi-Pack Packaging — Disorganised Retail Presentation
strips.desc: Problem: Eraser multi-packs where erasers move freely in the packaging create a disordered retail display — erasers at random positions and orientations. Solution: Multi-cavity APET tray with individual cavity for each eraser in the multi-pack — all erasers at uniform orientation, count visible from the front.

strips.title: Tamper Evidence for Small Stationery Items at Retail
strips.desc: Problem: Small stationery items (erasers, sharpeners) without tamper-evident packaging are subject to product removal at retail. Solution: APET blister heat-sealed to paperboard card — tamper-evident seal that cannot be opened and resealed without visible damage.
